status_summary: The Open America's Waters Act, introduced in the Senate as S. 2043 and in the House as H.R. 3940 on 2025-06-12, would repeal the Jones Act restrictions on coastwise trade by rewriting the coastwise endorsement statute and repealing related provisions. The only recorded actions are referral to the Senate Commerce Committee and, for the House bill, to the Coast Guard and Maritime Transportation Subcommittee on 2025-06-13; no hearing or markup is recorded in govinfo bill status. Separately, a waiver dated 2026-03-17 and issued at the Department of War's request was extended a second time for 90 days from 2026-08-17, with covered cargo to be loaded by 2026-11-15, per CBP guidance; a waiver is an existing executive tool and does not change the statute.
